sn9.5:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Ānando Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Ānando ativelaṃ gihisaññattibahulo viharati || || Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā āyasmato Ānandassa anukampikā atthakāmā āyasmantam Ānandam saṃvejetukāmā yenāyasmā Ānando ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.5:2.1: Rukkhamūlagahanaṃ pasakkiya || nibbānaṃ hadayasmiṃ opiya || jhāya Gotama mā ca pamādo || kiṃ te biḷibiḷikā karissatī ti || ||
sn9.5:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando tāya devatāya saṃvejito saṃvegam āpādī ti || ||
